_instructions: Copy this file to ~/.browsing_tracker/config.json and fill in your values.
For smtp_password use a Gmail App Password, NOT your account password.
Generate an App Password at: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords
Get your Anthropic API key at: https://console.anthropic.com/
To find your Firefox profile name, run: python3 list_profiles.py
Or open Firefox and go to: about:profiles
_firefox_profile_instructions: Set firefox_profile to the exact folder name of the profile you want to track.
Run 'python3 list_profiles.py' to see all available profiles.
Leave as null to auto-select the first default profile found.
